guilt_prone: This means living up to one's own picture of oneself, with conscience the judge: a misdeed gnaws at one though nobody knows of it, and confessing it brings relief.
shame_prone: This means living under others' eyes: stung by ridicule or rejection, even imagined, untroubled by a fault so long as it never gets out, and finding no relief in confessing.
punishment_fearing: This means avoiding offenses and misdeeds because one fears being punished for them, whether by the courts, the gods, hellfire, karma, vengeful spirits or a lynch mob.
